comments.before: Tier III Uptime-certified national DC. 1000 sqm 400 racks. Groundbreaking March 2021; launched November 2025. Investment ~P100M (~USD 7.3M). Located at Botswana Innovation Hub. Carrier-neutral. IXP peering on site.. [BoFiNet 2023 Annual Report](https://www.bofinet.co.bw/downloads/BoFiNet_2023_Annual_Report_Website__compressed.pdf) (100% govt owned); [Trade.gov Botswana Telecoms](https://www.trade.gov/country-commercial-guides/botswana-telecommunications); [BoFiNet Wikipedia](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Botswana_Fibre_Networks); [DCD Launch Article](https://www.datacenterdynamics.com/en/news/botswana-launches-first-national-data-center/) Launched 25 November 2025; Uptime Tier III Constructed Facility award 23 October 2025 (BOPA). Zhong Gan was main contractor, with 18 citizen subcontractors (Connecting Africa, November 2025). BoFiNet gives 'over P100 million' for the data centre and 1,000 sqm as its size; neither BoFiNet nor BW Techzone (June 2023) says the 1,000 sqm is white space. In September 2026 the communications minister said the whole government system is being migrated to a secure government cloud at the centre, and that the Digital Services Act of 2025 requires all public and private services to be online by November 2027 (BOPA, 23 September 2026).

Carrier-neutral. IXP peering on site.. [BoFiNet 2023 Annual Report](https://www.bofinet.co.bw/downloads/BoFiNet_2023_Annual_Report_Website__compressed.pdf) (100% govt owned); [Trade.gov Botswana Telecoms](https://www.trade.gov/country-commercial-guides/botswana-telecommunications); [BoFiNet Wikipedia](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Botswana_Fibre_Networks); [DCD Launch Article](https://www.datacenterdynamics.com/en/news/botswana-launches-first-national-data-center/) Launched 25 November 2025; Uptime Tier III Constructed Facility award 23 October 2025 (BOPA). Zhong Gan was main contractor, with 18 citizen subcontractors (Connecting Africa, November 2025). BoFiNet gives 'over P100 million' for the data centre and 1,000 sqm as its size; neither BoFiNet nor BW Techzone (June 2023) says the 1,000 sqm is white space. In September 2026 the communications minister said the whole government system is being migrated to a secure government cloud at the centre, and that the Digital Services Act of 2025 requires all public and private services to be online by November 2027 (BOPA, 23 September 2026). BoFiNet announced the launch of the Digital Delta Internet Exchange Point, reported 6 October 2026, for internet service providers, mobile operators and content and cloud providers to exchange local traffic in Botswana; the account gives no member count or traffic figure.
